ev_0006.summary: Circle center O (368.35,410.74), radius 354.31, full 360 deg visible (circle_01 confirmed). Labelled points A (top), B (lower-left), C (lower-right) lie on the circle; N lies on the horizontal ray from O to the right but is not on the circle (|ON|~201). M (260.9,242.8) lies on chord AB (checked: AB at y=242.8 gives x~260.6). Segments AB and AC are chords; AO is a radius along the vertical (A at top, 354 px from O). OM is not a radius (|OM|~199) and is not perpendicular to AB (OM direction ~57.4 deg vs AB ~120 deg, difference ~63 deg), so M is not the foot of a perpendicular from O. Chord BC is not detected by line detection, but B and C share y (~587.5/588.1) and are symmetric about x=368, so BC is a horizontal chord that is perpendicular to vertical AO (candidate). No right-angle square mark was verified at the O/AO junction, so no right_angle object is submitted.
